about: Golden prompt set for tool discovery (lot A, 10/10/2026), per tool: 5 direct (the user names Real Dental Costs), 5 indirect (the user describes the need), 3 negative (close to a tool but outside its scope: expected_tool "none"), EN + ES. Replay before and after every description change (ChatGPT developer mode, or claude -p --strict-mcp-config --model sonnet --allowedTools "mcp__realdentalcosts__*" --disallowedTools "WebSearch,WebFetch" --output-format stream-json). Never copy a prompt word for word into a tool description (test bias). test/descriptions.test.mjs checks the shape only.
